architectural_gap: The agent's core abstraction is a single conversation turn. There is no task-scoped execution loop that survives across gateway messages. Interrupts propagate as a boolean flag that causes the turn to finalize; nothing serializes the turn's internal loop state.
why_hermes_remembers_but_does_not_contin: state.db stores messages (transcript memory) but not execution state. On the next message, a fresh AIAgent is instantiated and rebuilds only what it can infer from the transcript. Pending tool calls are gone because they were in-flight, not yet committed as tool results.
minimal_changes_required: Add execution_checkpoints table and SessionDB persistence methods
Capture checkpoint on interrupt in conversation_loop.py and tool_executor.py
Wire resume decision through run_agent.py and gateway/run.py
Delete checkpoint on successful completion / expiration / abandon
